description: Checks at the Receita Federal whether the company is on the public list of the Sintonia A+ seal. Uses one lookup from the paid package, with no free quota. Without balance: 402 with offers. `data.selo_sintonia` comes with grade A+, cycle and validity, or `null` when the company is not on the list (the other grades are confidential by law). The same account or wallet checking the same company in the same list cycle does not pay again.

cnpj.description: CNPJ without punctuation: 14 digits or the alphanumeric one (12 letters or digits and 2 check digits), such as 12ABC34501DE35.
